snippet.title: Avatar Paintball (5/29/2010)
snippet.description:
Official description: Take your very own Avatar into the battlefield and compete online in Avatar Paintball. Play online with up to 16 players, in a fully 3D world, complete with weapon unlocks, battlefield power-ups and portals! Compete with the rest of the world with the global high-score list.

RELEASE DATE: 5/29/2010
DEVELOPER: DigitalDNA
GENRE: Shooter
Offline players 1
Online multiplayer 2 - 16
